basics.name: Le Yu
basics.position: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Ads Modeling & Bidding
basics.summary: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Ads Modeling & Bidding

projects.description: Drove the end-to-end design and launch of a hybrid delayed-GMV model for Target ROAS bidding, fusing delay curves with click and real-time funnel signals to predict final GMV before feedback matured. The initial IAA launch improved advertiser value by about 7%.

Designed and launched a multi-day MPC controller that incorporated historical spend and predicted GMV into each bidding decision to correct accumulated delivery gaps. An IAP experiment increased the share of campaigns meeting ROAS targets by about 14% and advertiser value by about 37%.

Built minute-level state–action–reward trajectories, RTG targets, and training and serving pipelines for sequence-based bidding. Prototyped Decision Transformer and generator–critic–value models with controller-based action bounds and safety priors.

Designed and launched a production App Ads diagnosis agent for ticket parsing, funnel triage, and bidding and ranking investigations. Authored its modular Skills and integrated internal tools with evidence and confidence controls to deliver traceable diagnoses while separating verified findings from hypotheses.

PACS-FL keeps privacy-sensitive conversion labels in a protected sandbox, exchanging intermediate tensors and gradients with cloud workers for split training. Drove Framework 2.0 for Lead Ads: a C++/Proto training interface with a unified label-feature pipeline, validated automatic cloud-sandbox graph partitioning, and single-job orchestration across GPU batch, CPU batch, and streaming stages, cutting PS storage by 70% and batch time by 90%.

Drove the staged unification of trackable and privacy-restricted traffic across on- and off-platform Lead Ads into one multi-head model with shared training and serving. Traffic-conditioned adapters and a compact sparse-feature tower preserved segment-specific behavior. The broader One Model program shipped through 18 production launches across US, EU, and ROW, with individual unification launches delivering up to 18.6% advertiser-value lift

Launched multiple recall branches using complementary privacy-safe signals: ELAND landing-page interaction graphs for U2I matching; Memory Recall for cluster-based candidate transfer; Cohort and DP behavioral features; and PACS-FL pCVR for eCPM retrieval.

Built bidirectional sample and feature pipelines between Promote and TikTok's recommendation system, allowing promotion models to use organic engagement signals and recommendation models to learn from paid-promotion feedback.

Launched Promote Internal Ads, Ad4Ad, and Promote-to-Live, building their CVR models and conversion pipelines. For Promote-to-Live, replaced daily updates with streaming training and modeled delayed watch-time labels.

highlights: Built LSTM baselines over hundreds of proprietary market features for equity time-series forecasting.
Fine-tuned BERT to classify articles for Bing News and support personalized newsletter curation.
Developed a ResNet-based visual model for detecting unauthorized and reposted videos on WeChat Channels.
Analyzed global cloud-computing markets and competitors to support Tencent Cloud product planning.
Improved an N-gram language model for first-page result reranking in Bing Search.

publications.summary: In the second paper, he applied the quantum theory to light to explain the photoelectric effect. In particular, he used the idea of light quanta (photons) to explain experimental results, but stressed the importance of the experimental results. The importance of his work on the photoelectric effect earned him the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921.
